Named axis collectives

Source: R/lax_parallel.R
lax_collectives.Rd

Ports of jax.lax.psum, pmean, pmax, pmin, axis_index, all_gather, ppermute, pshuffle, pbroadcast, all_to_all, pswapaxes and psum_scatter. On one device they apply to axes named by an enclosing vmap(..., axis_name = name).

Usage

lax_psum(x, axis_name, axis_index_groups = NULL)

lax_pmax(x, axis_name, axis_index_groups = NULL)

lax_pmin(x, axis_name, axis_index_groups = NULL)

lax_pmean(x, axis_name, axis_index_groups = NULL)

lax_axis_index(axis_name)

lax_axis_size(axis_name)

lax_all_gather(
  x,
  axis_name,
  axis_index_groups = NULL,
  axis = 0L,
  tiled = FALSE
)

lax_psum_scatter(
  x,
  axis_name,
  scatter_dimension = 0L,
  axis_index_groups = NULL,
  tiled = FALSE
)

lax_psum_scatter_start(
  x,
  axis_name,
  scatter_dimension = 0L,
  axis_index_groups = NULL,
  tiled = FALSE
)

lax_ppermute(x, axis_name, perm)

lax_pshuffle(x, axis_name, perm)

lax_pbroadcast(x, axis_name, source)

lax_all_to_all(
  x,
  axis_name,
  split_axis,
  concat_axis,
  axis_index_groups = NULL,
  tiled = FALSE
)

lax_pswapaxes(x, axis_name, axis, axis_index_groups = NULL)

Arguments

x

A pytree of arrays.

axis_name

Axis name (or several names for reductions).

axis_index_groups

Not supported (must be NULL).

axis

0-based position of the gathered axis.

tiled

Concatenate instead of stacking.

scatter_dimension

0-based dimension split across the axis.

perm

List of c(source, destination) index pairs (0-based).

source

0-based source index.

split_axis, concat_axis

0-based axes.

Value

lax_psum_scatter_start() returns a future: call $done() on it to get the result of lax_psum_scatter(). With one device the reduction runs eagerly, so there is no communication to overlap.
